title: Survey roadmap
description: Shows the sequence of the eight main paper sections and where the seven supplementary sections support them.
reading_note: Use S1–S3 for joint-specific evidence, S4–S6 for methods and S7 for benchmark comparisons.

title: Clinical target, vision output and validation
description: Uses ankle motion during swing to link a clinical variable, a video estimate and a reference measurement.
reading_note: Write down the joint angle and gait phase before comparing the estimated angle with the synchronised reference.

title: Screening and eligibility
description: Shows identification, deduplication, title and abstract screening, and full-text eligibility.
reading_note: Follow the exclusion branches to see which decisions were recorded at each stage.

title: Classification of the literature
description: Groups examples of clinical and instrumented evidence alongside human action recognition, video gait and pose estimation.
reading_note: Use the clinical branch to choose a gait variable and the vision branch to find ways to estimate it.

title: Gait cycle
description: Shows the sequence of events and phases in a gait cycle.
reading_note: Check the event definitions before comparing joint angles or timing across studies.

title: Joint mobility problems
description: Illustrates joint mobility problems in the body and locates the lower-limb joints covered by the survey.
reading_note: Read the hip, knee and ankle sections for the joint-specific measures used in walking studies.

title: Hip, knee and ankle range of motion
description: Illustrates sagittal-plane flexion and extension at the hip, knee and ankle.
reading_note: Check the angle convention and camera view when comparing a video estimate with a reference.

title: Action recognition for joint mobility assessment
description: Shows pose estimation followed by extraction of joint, gait and motion features.
reading_note: Look for a separate angular or temporal validation when a model is used to measure joint movement.

title: Skeleton-based action recognition
description: Shows a skeleton-based workflow with a neural network, joint-specific outputs and a report.
reading_note: Use S4 and S7 to check the dataset, split and outcome behind a classification result.

title: Human pose estimation for joint mobility assessment
description: Links body pose estimation to applications in rehabilitation, gait and joint mobility assessment.
reading_note: Check the visibility of the landmarks and the evaluation setting for the movement of interest.

title: Timeline of selected studies
description: Places selected clinical, gait, action recognition and pose studies in publication order.
reading_note: Follow the numbered citations to the paper records. The timeline shows examples discussed in the review.

title: Computer vision research directions
description: Brings together computer vision methods and research directions for joint mobility assessment.
reading_note: Read the discussion alongside this figure to identify the population, recording conditions and outcome needed for a follow-up study.
